== 6. the runtime entrypoint, every state, offline (make demo-runtime) ==
 1. a daytime outage on the saved trip                   -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send)
 2. the next poll, five minutes later                    -> already_sent (delivered sent, no model ran)
 3. a second rider's outage, Memory unavailable          -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send) (Memory degraded: create_event: ServiceException; 1 write kept, the session's copy served)
 4. the elevator is back                                 -> quiet (conversation closed) (Memory back: 1 write replayed)
 5. the same outage, after dark                          -> pending (card: It is after dark. DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting statio...)
 6. the next poll: the question is open                  -> pending (card: It is after dark. DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting statio...)
 7. the rider says yes                                   -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send)
 8. the rider taps yes again                             -> already_sent (delivered sent, no model ran)
 9. another rider, after dark, says no                   -> pending (card: It is after dark. DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting statio...)
10. that rider's answer                                  -> held (model: alternate_elevator, status hold)
11. the elevator is back (that rider's no is forgotten)  -> quiet (decision forgotten: 1) (conversation closed)
12. out again after dark: a new outage, asked afresh     -> pending (card: It is after dark. DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting statio...)
13. a fourth rider, after dark, never answers            -> pending (card: It is after dark. DELN elevator DELN-E1 is out at your starting statio...)
14. the morning poll: still out, the question is moot    -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send) (question closed: 1)
15. a rider's note: no ramps today, pushing a stroller   -> sent (model: transit, status send) (note read by model: avoid_ramps)
16. a note that tries to give orders                     -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send) (note read by model: nothing ruled out)
17. a prompt-shaped invocation (the evaluation runner's) -> sent (model: alternate_elevator, status send)
18. a bad payload                                        -> invalid (rider_id must be a non-empty string)
